Theme

subscription noun

also subscribe, monthly subscription, subscription fee

our formation

Cic. Att. 16.2.1: ex tertiā pēnsiōne (Lewis & Short)

pēnsiō, pēnsiōnis f.

noun, third declension

a regular payment: a subscription

Our use: no reference work has a word for a subscription. Classically pēnsiō is a payment due at a set term, and the lexicon already pays by pēnsiōnēs (pay in instalments). A subscription is a pēnsiō mēnstrua or annua, paid for as long as one wants the thing.

Other words

  • subscrīptiō, subscrīptiōnis f. — a signature

    noun, third declension · avoid · modern · M-O s.v. subscribe (to a periodical); Traupman 262: subscrībō

    Classically a signature or a line written underneath (Lewis & Short). Morgan–Owens warns that such words mean writing at the end of something, not subscribing; Traupman gives subscrībō among his computer terms.

Examples

  • Pēnsiōnem mēnstruam solvimus.

    We pay a monthly subscription.composed

See also pay in instalments, pay.

SourcesLewis & Short: pensio · Lewis & Short: subscriptio
